midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary body text, headline base, nav text — the default foreground against every surface

slate-600.$description: Slate 600 — Secondary text, button borders on outlined/ghost actions, list markers

graphite-800.$description: Graphite 800 — Dark surface fills for secondary buttons, dark cards, reverse sections

steel-500.$description: Steel 500 — Muted helper text, secondary link text, inactive nav

fog-400.$description: Fog 400 — Icon strokes, tertiary metadata, placeholder text

mist-300.$description: Mist 300 — Disabled controls, subtle borders, secondary dividers

cloud-200.$description: Cloud 200 — Hairline borders, icon outlines, the dominant UI border color across the system

paper-100.$description: Paper 100 — Page background, list rows, subtle section tints

snow-50.$description: Snow 50 — Card surfaces, elevated panels, button text on dark fills, the top of the surface stack

coral-pulse.$description: Coral Pulse — Brand emphasis color — highlights one line of display headlines, marks active nav links, outlines ghost CTA borders, the coral-red ink of the editorial system

coral-500.$description: Coral 500 — Red action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

cobalt-link.$description: Cobalt Link — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lilac-whisper.$description: Lilac Whisper — Decorative card border tint on case-study cards — a barely-there violet that softens the otherwise monochrome system

banner-gradient.$description: Banner Gradient — Top announcement banner — pink to violet sweep signals urgency and brand energy without adding permanent surface noise

inter.$description: Sole brand typeface — handles everything from 12px micro-labels to 80px display headlines. Weight 500/600 for headlines keeps the voice confident without shouting; weight 400 carries body text. The tight letter-spacing on large sizes (-0.025em at 80px, -0.019em at 40–48px) makes display lines feel set, not stacked.

ui-monospace.$description: Inline code, keyboard shortcuts, technical tokens — appears sparingly, never as a headline face
